notes: §7.2.1: "Core names are prelude items whose *spelling* comes from the skin table. They cannot be declared, redefined or shadowed (K0413), so translating them never changes meaning." A local `let` that reuses the file's own spelling of `print` redefines a core name. The converted skins use their own spelling (`اطبع`, `ektb`). (§10.1.2 also lists core names under K0405; §7.2 and §27 name K0413, so this case expects K0413.)
